definitions.explanation: The unrefined or rough portion of something.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{粗|あら}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for faults in others.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}の{粗|あら}を{指摘|してき}する。
examples.english: To point out the flaws in the plan.

notes:
{粗|あら} refers to faults or rough parts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粗|あら}を{探|さが}す (to look for faults)
- {粗|あら}が{見|み}える (flaws become visible)
- {粗|あら}{探|さが}し (fault-finding)

RELATED WORDS:
- {粗|あら}い: rough, coarse (adjective)
- {欠点|けってん}: fault, shortcoming
- {粗末|そまつ}: poor quality, crude
